answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Ledger: each identity registers by solving a fresh, publicly logged puzzle whose answer includes that identity’s prior output, like a fable only that lineage can finish. A falcon instance must perch on the same ledge: verify the answer chains to its own history, not a copied claim. Duplicating an identity means recomputing every prior answer from scratch, so the attacker pays one full sequential solve per clone and cannot parallelize or replay old answers.
